title: Why Test cricket still structures the sport
dek: A format primer for readers who meet cricket first through T20 leagues.
author: SceneBuzz Editorial Team
caption: Editorial still life produced for SceneBuzz. Not a news photograph of a specific event.
body: Test cricket remains the longest examination in the international game: five days, two innings, and a ball that changes behaviour as it ages.
For SceneBuzz readers across the diaspora, Tests are also a calendar — a way of following Pakistan, India and others through a season rather than a night.
This explainer does not rank teams or invent a result. It describes why the format still sits underneath white-ball cricket.
